shape: A first-year research methods project as plain text: eight paired measurements (hours of sleep, mean reaction time in ms).
tests: A scatter graph: each point is [hours of sleep, reaction time], the right way round with the axis titles to match, and no correlation coefficient is invented.

keyFacts.fact: Whether students who slept less have slower reaction times.
Eight volunteers, self-reported sleep, five ruler-drop tests each, mean taken.
Under six hours everyone was above 280 ms; seven hours or more everyone was below 265 ms.
With eight people and self-reported sleep, can't say sleep caused it.

forbidden.why: No correlation or significance test is in the material.
The material says it can't show cause.
